ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.frequency_basis: 3 quarterly DPS facts inside FY2025 (2025-01-01..2025-12-31) plus one payment carried only in the FY total; the per-share facts are filed per quarter — a payment cadence inside the quarter (a monthly payer) is not tagged
dividends.fy_label_basis: calendar year of the fiscal period end (the annual table's convention)
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30
dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (4/4 quarters filed) + buybacks (4/4 quarters filed) − share_issuance (4/4 quarters filed); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30
notes: split ratio 1.5 is tagged at 2 context dates (2014-06-02, 2014-07-01) — one split, read once at 2014-06-02

split 1.5 tagged at 2014-06-02: facts filed before 2014-08-08 are on the pre-split basis — the diluted share count for the period ended 2013-06-30 was re-filed ×1.50 on 2014-08-08 (last filed on the old basis 2013-08-08)

annual_dps: FY DPS for the period ended 2012-12-31 is filed as 0.6 (10-K filed 2013-02-28, 10-K filed 2014-02-28) and as 0.4 (10-K filed 2015-02-27) — restated for the 1.5-for-1 split effective 2014-06-02 (first filed on the new basis 2014-08-08); 0.4 used (the latest filing on the new share basis, CommonStockDividendsPerShareDeclared)

annual_dps: FY DPS for the period ended 2013-12-31 is filed as 0.68 (10-K filed 2014-02-28) and as 0.45 (10-K filed 2015-02-27, 10-K filed 2016-02-26) — restated for the 1.5-for-1 split effective 2014-06-02 (first filed on the new basis 2014-08-08); 0.45 used (the latest filing on the new share basis, CommonStockDividendsPerShareDeclared)

quarterly DPS (declared): 4 quarter(s) filed at different values on the same share basis (2010-06-30: 0.15 (filed 2010-08-06) used, not 0.1 (filed 2011-08-08) — the value the year-to-date facts give (2010-01-01..2010-06-30 − 2010-01-01..2010-03-31); 2010-09-30: 0.15 (filed 2010-11-08) used, not 0.11 (filed 2011-11-08) — the filing that first reported the quarter (the year-to-date facts do not decide); 2019-06-30: 0.1725 (filed 2020-11-05) used, not 0.64 (filed 2021-02-25) — the filing that first reported the quarter (the year-to-date facts do not decide); 2019-09-30: 0.1725 (filed 2020-11-05) used, not 0.69 (filed 2021-02-25) — the filing that first reported the quarter (the year-to-date facts do not decide)) — later 10-Ks and comparatives sometimes tag a year-to-date or annual value with a three-month context

split adjustment (declared DPS): 19 facts for periods ending 2007-12-31..2013-03-31 were last filed before the 1.5-for-1 split effective 2014-06-02 (first filed on the new basis 2014-08-08) and are divided by the filed ratio (StockholdersEquityNoteStockSplitConversionRatio1) to today's share basis

dps_ttm: the latest four quarterly DPS facts are not consecutive quarters (182 days between 2025-09-30 and 2026-03-31) — FY2025 DPS 1.08 + the quarters since (2026-03-31: 0.33, 2026-06-30: 0.33) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-03-31: 0.27, 2025-06-30: 0.27)
